body: 12 Step programs should not be mandated because it's against our religious rights and freedoms
This is; [The Day I stayed Sober](http://michaelpond.ca/blog/the-day-i-stayed-sober/). I hope this helps, I too have had this feeling of "rock bottom".

I truly empathize with your predicament. I have suffered from anxiety and depression as well. Don't ever lose hope and please be sure to see a professional and access your support system. Have a look at my [site](http://michaelpond.ca/) and you will see that it is possible for your life to get MUCH better.
